newsitem.title: UK: TABLE TENNIS-DENG RETAINS WOMEN'S TITLE.
newsitem.headline: TABLE TENNIS-DENG RETAINS WOMEN'S TITLE.

text.p: Olympic champion Deng Yaping stepped up a gear after losing the opening game to overwhelm fellow Chinese Wang Nan and retain her world table tennis singles title on Monday.
The stocky 24-year-old Deng had too much power and guile for her teenage rival, winning 12-21 21-8 21-11 21-10 to underline her reputation as the foremost female player of the modern era.
There was little emotion when she completed her victory, merely a short, sharp clenched fist to mark her success.
Wang, 19, came into the final with confidence, suggesting there was little in Deng's game to fear except her greater experience.

That proved to be the vital factor. Deng began slowly and tentatively and Wang had plenty of time to play her shots as she rolled to the opening game. But when Deng turned up the heat, Wang started to wilt and the champion raced to victory in just under an hour.
